scripts.agents:check: agent-tool skills check && agent-tool permissions check
scripts.agents:sync: agent-tool skills install --apply && agent-tool permissions install --apply
scripts.android:build-release: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android build_release
scripts.android:listing: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android listing
scripts.android:promote-release: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android promote_release
scripts.android:readiness: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android readiness
scripts.android:upload-release: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane android upload_release
scripts.ios:build-release: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane ios build_release
scripts.ios:listing: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane ios listing
scripts.ios:profiles: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane ios profiles
scripts.ios:readiness: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane ios readiness
scripts.ios:upload-release: NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bundle exec fastlane ios upload_release
scripts.test: bun test fastlane web l10n scripts/testing
scripts.web:deploy: bun run web:build && wrangler deploy --config web/wrangler.jsonc
